description: The affected Notamon can't be swapped for another one. Receives damage each turn equal to 8% of its maximum HP.
The affected Notamon receives damage each turn equal to 8% of its maximum HP.
The affected Notamon has a 35% chance of failing when using a skill. If this happens, it receives damage equal to 8% of its maximum HP.
All skills that the affected Notamon uses are not effective
The affected Notamon has a 50% chance of failing when using a skill.
The affected Notamon receives 30% extra damage from non-elemental attacks.
The affected Notamon can't use any skills, unless it's a Fire skill (which also removes Freeze). Each turn there is a 30% chance that the Notamon will thaw.
The affected Notamon receives damage each turn equal to 12% of its maximum HP.
The affected Notamon receives damage each turn equal to 15% of its maximum HP, if it's asleep. This effect is cured if the Notamon is no longer asleep.
The affected Notamon receives no damage from incoming attacks.
The affected Notamon receives damage each turn equal to 10% of its maximum HP. The opponent will be healed for the same amount, even if it's not the original cause of this status effect.
The affected Notamon has a 60% chance of failing when using a skill, if it was using the same skill last turn.
The affected Notamon has a 30% chance of failing when using a skill.
The affected Notamon can neither be swapped or escape from the battle.
The affected Notamon receives damage each turn equal to 10% of its maximum HP.
The affected Notamon can't inflict status effects.
The affected Notamon can only use the same skill as last turn, otherwise it loses its turn.
The affected Notamon restores HP each turn equal to 8% of its maximum HP.
The affected Notamon can't be healed. Incoming heals are nullified.
The afftected Notamon can't use any skills or evade attacks.
The affected Notamon won't drop below 1HP for the duration of this effect.
